text:
Welcome to Co Loa Citadel, or Khu di tích Cổ Loa, one of the most historic sites in Vietnam. This ancient fortified complex is located in the Dong Anh area and is deeply associated with the legend of Au Lac and the reign of An Duong Vuong. As you explore, you will see impressive earthen ramparts, temples, and communal buildings that date back centuries.

The ticket price for visiting this remarkable site is 30,000 VND. It’s important to note that the site is open daily from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. While wandering through, be aware that the ramparts extend through nearby residential areas, and not all sections are gated.

One of the fascinating legends tied to Co Loa is the story of My Chau, which adds a rich narrative to your experience here. As you immerse yourself in the history and legends, keep your camera ready to capture the stunning architecture and landscape that this citadel offers.

Before you go, remember that visiting hours can sometimes vary, so it’s always a good idea to reach out to local operators for the most current information. Enjoy your time at Co Loa Citadel!
